title: The White House built five Trump-themed video games, and they're bleak

article.title: The White House built five Trump-themed video games, and they're bleak
article.summary: In recent months, we've seen the Trump administration grasp at every straw it can to appeal to youth who, by and large, think its figurehead is a spray-tanned monster concerned only with his own self-enrichment by any means necessary. Paying off TikTokers is one thing, but as an inveterate gamer, I've been simultaneously fascinated and appalled by the ways in which the White House has co-opted my beloved hobby as a vehicle for propaganda. — Read the rest The post The White House built five Trump-themed video games, and they're bleak appeared first on Boing Boing .
